launches.body:
Hi, we’re [Victor](https://www.linkedin.com/in/victor-luo/), [Gary](https://www.linkedin.com/in/zhuang-luo/), [Huimin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/huimin-xie/) - cofounders of Perfectly👋

We're announcing our product launch: **Paul, the AI recruiter that replaces an entire recruiting team!**

Launch Video: [**https://youtu.be/BiAyAGuWQAc**](https://youtu.be/BiAyAGuWQAc)

\
Hiring great people still looks like this: 5 months. 200 phone screens. 80 first rounds. 20 onsites.

We know because we lived it. As ML scientists at TikTok, we personally sat through **600+ badly sourced recruiting interviews** just to hire a few engineers. Entire roadmaps stalled because we couldn’t hire fast enough.

**Meet Paul:** Paul isn’t just a tool; he’s your entire recruiting team in one AI agent. He handles the intake, sourcing, outreach, and screening. Most of this is invisible to you, **until high-quality, interview-ready candidates just show up in your Slack.**

**Paul nurtures candidates to close them before they even get to offer**. He spots concerns before they appear, prepare them for interviews, and proactively reaches out to ensure you don’t lose your most promising candidates.

Since starting YC, we’re already helping startups like **Giga, Corgi, LlamaIndex, Porter**, and dozens more hire faster.

**We’re seeing:**

* **4× faster hiring**
* **10× candidate volume**
* **2× higher interview pass rates**

**Behind the scenes, it’s even more impressive.**

* **Increased recruiting efficiency by 20x: from 20 hours to 1 hour**
* **Improved candidate interview retention by 250%**

With AI, we can understand candidate preferences more deeply than any human could. And that lets us match them more reliably.

Get started for free now: [**hm.perfectly.so**](https://hm.perfectly.so/)

Or speak with the team [here](https://calendly.com/huimin-perfectly/30min).

launches.title: Meet Perfectly, the world’s first autonomous recruiting team.
launches.tagline: Onboard your roles, and interview qualified candidates without managing anything.
launches.body:
Meet Perfectly, the world’s first autonomous recruiting team. 

**TLDR:** For the first time, you can just tell a recruiting system exactly what you’re looking for, and it’ll send you qualified candidates until your role’s filled without you having to manage anything.

Launch video: <https://youtu.be/7WZOck_Psow>

Over the past year, we’ve become the best way to fill startup roles. 

* Worked with **over 50 startups and enterprises**, including Citizen, Corgi, and Tinyfish.
* **60% fill rate in 3 months or less**, even when competing against recruiting agencies.
* Responsible for **80% of our customer’s pipeline**, and many rely only on us.

**The Problem and Team**

We’re [Victor](https://www.linkedin.com/in/victor-luo/), [Gary](https://www.linkedin.com/in/zhuang-luo/), [Huimin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/huimin-xie/) - cofounders of Perfectly. **We are three research scientists who’s built TikTok’s recommendation algorithm** (Huimin was actually a founding scientist of the algorithm). 

We built 100 person orgs with the highest talent density at TikTok and Meta.

For startups, hiring is a near-impossible task. Most resort to agencies, who run one general search and send candidates when their vaguely a fit. 

If they run recruiting in-house, they learn quickly that sourcing and coordinating is incredibly manual, even with current AI tools. 

**The Best Way to Hire**

Perfectly builds a living, adapting model of your hiring judgement and runs the full recruiting process for any role. We source with **98% precision**, the highest across any service or tool.

1. Onboarding: You’re paired with a dedicated talent advisor that helps the system learn your exact judgement when hiring. 


2. Background Research: Perfectly does background research and ingests your previous candidates to understand your roles and company.
3. Sourcing: Perfectly maps the full candidate pool, and reaches out to qualified candidates based on real-time signals and understanding their actual work. 
4. Coordination: Perfectly coordinates only qualified candidates onto screens, answers questions, and nudges when candidates are stalled.
5. Self-improving: We listen in on each interview and automatically improve sourcing.

The best startups leverage their brand, founders, connections, and longterm candidate relationships to build a talent moat that compounds in better talent density. 

Do all that completely hands-off now by [booking a demo here](https://calendly.com/victor-perfectly/20min) or visit [perfectly.so](https://perfectly.so/)

launches.body:
Hi, we’re [Victor](https://www.linkedin.com/in/victor-luo/) and [Gary](https://www.linkedin.com/in/zhuang-luo/) - cofounders of Perfectly👋

Perfectly uses AI to fill roles by automating the grunt work of identifying, reaching out to, and screening qualified candidates. We are obsessed with one thing – **providing the highest quality candidates**.

**Launch Exclusive Offer: We’ll undercut your current agency by 50%** for your first role (or give you an exclusive discount), while filling your pipeline with BETTER candidates - all in the same day. Just mention YC Launch in your onboarding call.

Book a demo [here](https://calendly.com/victor-perfectly/30min).

Launch Video: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KaQCbD6UxwU>

**How We Started:**

Have you ever tried to fill a role with a recruiting agency? When we worked at TikTok, we sat through over 800 agency-sourced interviews. The pipelines moved slowly, the candidates were never top tier, and forget about filling any tough roles – most recruiters would rather ghost me. 

After working at TikTok on the world’s most advanced AI recommendation, we couldn’t believe how outdated our recruiting process was in comparison. 

**Our Solution:**

Our AI Recruiter has infinite memory and context to calibrate to your preferences deeper than any agency ever could.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97008&key=user_uploads/179090/8a1d922c-db08-4710-9903-4e07a7664f8e)

We do deep research into each candidate. Beyond surface level experience, it predicts their interests, trajectory, and how they’ll actually do in the interviews and on the job.

Then we’ll reach out and screen the best candidates, and they show up straight in your Slack.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97008&key=user_uploads/179090/1ffb94ec-86ff-4e8e-9b12-f4adf09f4c46)

When you approve, we’ll send them your calendar link to schedule an interview directly.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=97008&key=user_uploads/179090/06c50a8d-035c-4ca4-87a9-f96738f27be7)

We only get paid when we fill your role. Often, **we can fill your interviewing schedule the same day as your intake**. The most amazing thing is that we can do this while keeping the quality bar high. Customers tell us that Perfectly’s candidates pass interviews 2x more often, and with 10x the volume of a traditional agency.

**Why You Should Trust Us:**

It’s working so well, one of our clients fired all their other agencies two weeks into using us.

> We moved off Paraform and canceled our Juicebox subscription because of the velocity we saw from Perfectly - Caleb from Series A Stealth Startup

**Launch Exclusive Offer:**

Give Perfectly a try. **We’ll undercut your current agency by 50%** for your first role, while filling your pipeline with BETTER candidates - all in the same day.

If you don’t currently use an agency but want to try, we’re offering a YC Launch exclusive discount. Just mention YC Launch in your onboarding call.

Book a demo [here](https://calendly.com/victor-perfectly/30min).
